questions.question: Name and describe the three kinds of transformation.
questions.expected_answer: A translation slides a shape without turning it. A rotation turns a shape around a fixed point. A reflection flips a shape over a mirror line to make a mirror image. In each one, the shape keeps its size and shape.

questions.question: A right-angled triangle is reflected over one of its shorter sides. Describe the composite shape.
questions.expected_answer: The two triangles make a bigger triangle with two equal sides. The mirror line, the side it was reflected over, is a line of symmetry of the new shape.

questions.question: What is a tessellation? Name a shape that tessellates and one that does not.
questions.expected_answer: A tessellation is a pattern of shapes that covers a surface with no gaps and no overlaps. Squares tessellate. Circles do not, because they leave gaps.
